description: Replacing a system gradually by putting a new app in front of it, moving routes one at a time and forwarding the rest until the old app serves nothing.
Microsoft's reverse proxy library for ASP.NET Core (`Yarp.ReverseProxy`), used here to forward unmigrated routes to the .NET Framework app.
A catch-all `MapForwarder("/{**catch-all}", ...)` with the lowest order, so routes the new app defines always win.
The `Microsoft.AspNetCore.SystemWebAdapters` packages that let libraries using `System.Web` types run on both stacks and provide remote session and remote authentication.
Upgrading libraries leaves first and the main web app last, so each library's dependencies are already compatible when it moves.
Microsoft's recommended AI-assisted upgrade agent in Visual Studio, which plans the upgrade and commits each change for review.
The earlier upgrade tool, now officially deprecated in favor of the Copilot modernization agent.
